lobby.title: Rules
lobby.rule1: Take turns: each shot is one try to pot balls.
lobby.rule2: A potted ball scores its value; the bigger and heavier it is, the harder it is to pot.
lobby.rule3: Fouls: cue ball potted, missing everything or running out of time cost points.
lobby.rule4: The rack lasts while balls remain; the highest score wins.
